packages.title: BetterTwitch
packages.shortDescription: BetterTwitch: Twitch for webOS with ad blocking, up to 1440p, Audio only, 7TV/BTTV/FFZ emotes, Unicode emoji rendering, low latency mode (fixed 1.50x), 20-second latency recovery, First Message and deleted-message marks, channel points and chat overlay.
